correctness.rationale: For the smooth quartic X=V(sum x_j^3 x_{j+1}) and G=<diag(zeta^{1,58,9,34,20})>, 3a_j+a_{j+1}=0 mod61. All nonidentity projective stabilizers occur only at five coordinate points; the tangent characters there are scalar powers/permutations of (8,19,33), yielding five 1/61(8,19,33) germs. Directly enumerate k=1..60 ages; minimum 22/61 at k=39 with residues (7,9,6), positive but <1. Equivariant Picard descent from U=X minus five points yields Cl(Y)=Z+Z/61, and stabilizer fiber weight b-ma_j gives Cartier iff m=b=0 mod61, hence Pic(Y)=61Z, local rank-two image spanning (1,...,1) and (1,58,9,34,20). Quasi-etale canonical pullback and H^3(X)=4 imply Fano volume 4/61; Lefschetz fixed traces give invariant H^3=0 and Q-projective-space cohomology. Independent checks tested five invariance congruences, all 60 ages, all 61^2 local character pairs, rank-two image and unique Cartier residue.
